title: Decouple Engram base MCP/context from opt-in turn-gated control
outcome: Implement Greg's approved two-tier Engram product model after explicit go. BASE: every declared and host-authorized project receives the injected Engram MCP server and a SessionStart/PostCompact context nudge from engram work next, independent of control enforcement. PREMIUM: existing bind/evaluate/begin/checkpoint withholding remains behind a separate per-project Turn-gated control switch, default off. Current integration must remain unchanged while this item is on hold; do not enable Phoenix or alter project settings before approval.
acceptance: After explicit approval: declared+authorized projects receive Engram MCP regardless of premium control; SessionStart and PostCompact inject engram work next context with home, actor termal, session id and grant supplied only through the host environment; the settings UI separates derived Engram base enablement from a default-off Turn-gated control toggle; control-off sessions never bind or withhold; existing control E2E remains the premium test; focused and full quality gates pass; TermAl and Phoenix base activation is performed only when Greg explicitly requests it.
